question: What supported recovery contract should apply when `socket.drain` cannot be queued for a slow Gateway client?
rationale: Source inspection establishes the consequences of the current behavior, but only Gateway ownership can choose whether the durable public contract is disconnect-and-resync, best-effort delivery, or a bounded priority channel.

options.title: Disconnect and resync
options.body: Close overloaded clients with an explicit recoverable reason and require reconnect plus authoritative session-state resynchronization.

options.title: Drop and reconcile
options.body: Use ordinary frame shedding and require clients to periodically reconcile session state for eventual correctness.

options.title: Bounded priority delivery
options.body: Introduce a separately bounded lifecycle-event path with an explicit overflow fallback.

recommendation.title: Disconnect and resync
recommendation.body: Close overloaded clients with an explicit recoverable reason and require reconnect plus authoritative session-state resynchronization.

likelyOwner.reason: His recent current-main work owns the shared session-change projection and adjacent broadcaster behavior most directly affected by this decision.
